C1395.title: Default Credentials Vulnerability: The Case Study of Exposed IP Cameras
C1395.summary: A 2023 IEEE conference paper investigates the risks of default credentials in IoT devices, with a specific focus on IP cameras. The study finds that a large number of internet-connected IP cameras still use manufacturer default passwords, making them easily accessible to malicious actors.
